# twenty_role

Read an existing role without changing it. Specify exactly one of `role_id` or `label`; labels match case and whitespace exactly and must identify one role. Requires the `ROLES` settings permission.

## Example usage

```terraform
data "twenty_role" "existing" {
  label = "Admin"
}

# For UUID lookup, replace label with role_id.
# role_id = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
output "role_id" {
  value = data.twenty_role.existing.id
}
```

To look up a UUID instead, replace `label` with `role_id`. Use the [role resource](../resources/role.md) to manage custom roles.

Returned flags and global grants describe the role, not its complete effective permissions. Object/field rules are not exported.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `label` (String) Role label. When used as the selector, matching is exact and case-sensitive, including whitespace. A label must identify exactly one role. Specify exactly one of `role_id` or `label`.
- `role_id` (String) Role UUID to look up. Specify exactly one of `role_id` or `label`.

### Read-Only

- `can_access_all_tools` (Boolean) Whether the role grants access to all tools.
- `can_be_assigned_to_agents` (Boolean) Whether the role can be assigned to agents.
- `can_be_assigned_to_api_keys` (Boolean) Whether the role can be assigned to API keys.
- `can_be_assigned_to_users` (Boolean) Whether the role can be assigned to workspace users.
- `can_destroy_all_object_records` (Boolean) Whether the role grants permanent-delete access to all object records.
- `can_read_all_object_records` (Boolean) Whether the role grants read access to all object records. This data source does not read CRM records.
- `can_soft_delete_all_object_records` (Boolean) Whether the role grants soft-delete access to all object records.
- `can_update_all_object_records` (Boolean) Whether the role grants update access to all object records.
- `can_update_all_settings` (Boolean) Whether the role grants access to update all workspace settings.
- `description` (String) Role description, or null when the server has none.
- `icon` (String) Role icon identifier, or null when the server has none.
- `id` (String) Stable UUID of the matching role.
- `is_editable` (Boolean) Whether Twenty permits editing this role.
- `permission_flags` (Set of String) Explicit permission flag keys returned by Twenty. Global capability booleans can grant additional access. Null means the server did not return a flag list; an empty set means it returned no explicit flags.
